title: Design System: Shuhuai Zhang Personal Website

display.purpose: Names and page titles across all three canvases.

archive-heading.purpose: The active Research category heading above its strong rule.

paper-title.purpose: Compact research titles across long factual strings.

body.purpose: Biography, metadata, credits, controls, and supporting copy.

performance-title.purpose: Repertoire titles within the active carousel slide.

motion.name: page-canvas-leave
motion.purpose: Send the old named page canvas left when moving forward through About, Research, and Another Me; reverse the direction when moving backward.

motion.name: page-canvas-arrival
motion.purpose: Bring the new named page canvas from the right on forward navigation or from the left on backward navigation; reload does not slide.

motion.name: research-category-exchange
motion.purpose: Move Publications to Working Papers upward and return downward.

motion.name: carousel-film-strip
motion.purpose: Slide the complete performance record left for next and right for previous, unloading the old iframe after exit.

motion.name: stable-navigation
motion.purpose: Keep the transparent navigation above and spatially separate from the sliding page canvas.

motion.name: line-arrival
motion.purpose: Draw the About canvas boundary once on arrival.

motion.name: nav-underline
motion.purpose: Reveal the apricot navigation line on hover, focus, and the current route.

motion.name: color-state
motion.purpose: Resolve quiet color changes for navigation, tabs, titles, and carousel controls.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Collapse route, category, carousel, line, and state motion when reduced motion is requested.

narrative.overview:
One identity is expressed through two genuine registers. About and Research occupy a cool mineral-and-slate painterly world; Another Me shifts into aubergine, ivory, and apricot. Transparent left-grouped navigation, compressed Archivo display type, full-viewport fields, square geometry, and fine rules keep the three independent routes on one structural line.

The system is experiential but exact. About lets a full portrait field carry biography and contact information; Research makes a generated mineral field the atmosphere behind a functional two-node archive; Another Me sets one performance at a time against a warmer abstract field. The interface refuses boxed portfolio heroes, a permanent side rail, floating cards, ornamental chrome, and invented proof.
keyCharacteristics: Two coordinated painterly registers within one identity.
Transparent, horizontal, left-grouped navigation on every primary route.
Full-viewport fields with an edge-dissolving mineral reading mist rather than a white card.
Compressed sans type shared across the identity; measured serif type reserved for music.
Ruled research records and 16:9 performance media with restrained, progressive motion.

rules.name: The Two Registers Rule
rules.body: Cool painterly slate and mineral belong to academic reading; aubergine and ivory belong to performance; apricot and the one-pixel line make them siblings.

rules.name: The Contrast-Specific Focus Rule
rules.body: Use Academic Focus Clay on the pale Research field, apricot on dark interactive surfaces, and ivory around focused performance media.

rules.name: The Rare Accent Rule
rules.body: Apricot marks identity, selection, action, focus, or real media; it never becomes a general-purpose page surface.

rules.name: The Shared Display Rule
rules.body: Archivo owns the name, page titles, navigation, selector labels, and academic record on every route.

rules.name: The Serif Reserve Rule
rules.body: Alegreya is limited to the music introduction, performance titles, and repertoire detail; it does not replace the shared identity layer.

rules.name: The Full-Viewport Field Rule
rules.body: Generated imagery and tonal overlays span the canvas; the centered shell aligns content but never turns the route into a boxed portfolio hero.

rules.name: The One-Scroller Rule
rules.body: Research and Another Me use contained pane scrolling only above 900px; below that breakpoint, the document owns the scroll.

rules.name: The Horizontal Navigation Rule
rules.body: About, Research, and Another Me remain visible in one left-grouped row on desktop and mobile.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Construction Rule
rules.body: Use imagery, tonal overlays, rules, and controlled translucency to establish depth; do not introduce shadows, rounded glass, or floating layers.

rules.name: The Progressive Motion Rule
rules.body: Direction communicates sequence at the route, Research-category, and performance levels; enhancement disappears cleanly when unsupported or reduced, while content remains complete without JavaScript.

rules.name: The Square Media Rule
rules.body: Performance media remains 16:9, square-cornered, and attached to its active descriptive record.

rules.name: The Line-and-Node Rule
rules.body: Use one-pixel rules and small square nodes to express sequence and selection; do not substitute pills, chips, or badges.

dos: Do preserve the full generated portrait on About and the fixed generated painterly canvases on Research and Another Me.
Do keep the transparent navigation horizontal, visible, and grouped at the left on every viewport.
Do preserve Research as a two-node selector plus edge-dissolving mineral reading mist, with Publications active by default and a subtle overflow-only scroll indicator.
Do preserve the one-at-a-time horizontal performance carousel, post-exit iframe unloading, and real 16:9 media.
Do use contained pane scrolling only above 900px and whole-page scrolling below it.
Do preserve self-hosted Archivo across the identity and reserve self-hosted Alegreya for musical narrative.
Do keep Academic Focus Clay on pale academic surfaces and apricot or ivory focus treatment on dark surfaces.
Do preserve the About → Research → Another Me spatial order, keep navigation stable while canvases slide, make reload motionless, and collapse motion under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Do keep every panel and performance record sequentially readable when JavaScript is unavailable.
donts: Don't replace the Research painterly canvas with the former solid slate field or separate header band.
Don't turn the performance archive back into eight stacked rows; keep one active record in the carousel.
Don't introduce a permanent side rail, far-separated navigation, mobile drawer, decorative numbering, badges, or invented metadata.
Don't place the biography in a detached card or pale band, or obscure the portrait with interface chrome.
Don't harden the Research mist into an opaque white page or floating card; do not round the reading surfaces or media, add shadows, or introduce backdrop blur.
Don't replace directional exchanges with a uniform site-wide fade.
Don't spread apricot across general-purpose surfaces; its rarity carries identity and state.
Don't use Alegreya for academic headings, navigation, years, controls, or credits.
Don't fabricate portraits, logos, testimonials, research claims, performance records, or other visual proof.
